corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 2 L06 shows 'የነገድ' (the 'ገድ' was compressed/bled and misread as 'ጥ') and 'ዓሥሩ' with the 2nd-order vowel mark on ሩ, matching the parallel phrase in L13-17 ('በነገድ መቶ... ከመቶው ነገድ').
Same as L06: the printed word is 'የነገድ' ('leader of the tribe'), where 'ገድ' bled together and was misread as 'ጥ'.
The shortened right leg of 4th-order 'ካ' ('ካሥሩ' = ከ+አሥሩ, 'from the ten') is clearly visible on the image and required by Amharic grammar.
The 4th-order 'ካ' ('ካሥሩ' = ከ+አሥሩ, 'from the ten cities') is clearly printed with the shortened right leg.
Both visually and grammatically, the word is the Amharic gerund 'ከፍለህ' ('having divided for me, give me' — translating 'ሀበኒ መክፈልተ'), not 'ክፍልህ'.
